summary: Verified PHED consumer data import + ranked suggestion/autocomplete feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (26,407 consumers present, list search 'RAM' returns 10,404 total, ranked /consumers/search?q=RAM returns 'RAM SARUP', 'RAMESH KUMAR' as top-ranked prefix matches, exact consumer_id match works, 1,024 Didar Nagar properties present and filterable by colony). Frontend: on /admin/phed/consumers, typing 'RAM' in [data-testid=consumer-search-input] shows [data-testid=consumer-suggestions] dropdown with 8 items led by 'RAM SARUP' and two 'RAMESH KUMAR' entries; table filters live (25 rows); clicking a suggest-<id> item opens the consumer detail dialog correctly. Header shows '26407 consumers'.

minor.issue: 'search' param does not match colony values (returns 0), while colony=Didar Nagar works. Consider extending search to include colony field.

action_items: Optional: broaden /api/admin/properties?search= to also match 'colony' field (currently only matches other fields).
critical_code_review_comments: phed.py search_consumers() correctly implements 3-tier ranking (exact -> name prefix -> substring). Working well.
consumers list endpoint returns key 'consumers' (not 'items') and 'total' - documented for future testers.
phed.py at 1788 lines is large; consider splitting into consumers/connections/import submodules.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused already-imported data (26407 consumers, 1024 Didar Nagar properties).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend list response uses key 'consumers' (not 'items'); properties list uses 'properties'. Both include 'total'. Ranked endpoint /api/phed/consumers/search returns {results, exact_count}. Login endpoint returns 'token'/'refresh_token' (not access_token). Ward 1 THS id: dd7eab7c-fcb5-4649-8feb-89243dfb4c95. Requires X-Town-Code: THS header for direct API calls after admin login. Frontend flow: login -> /select-town -> click [data-testid=town-card-THS] -> /admin/phed/consumers.
rca of the issue: Original bug (search shows empty + no autocomplete) is fixed. Data import populated ward 1 of THS with 26,407 consumers; new /consumers/search endpoint plus PhedConsumers.js debounced dropdown (data-testid consumer-suggestions / suggest-<id>) provide the expected prefix-first suggestions. Verified end-to-end in browser.
